rationale: Transformer.apply_activation_checkpointing hard-coded preserve_rng_state=False even with nn.Dropout in the graph; backward recompute uses a fresh mask so gradients mismatch the original forward. Detection: at build, scan named_modules for nn.Dropout; if any exists, the checkpoint wrapper config must have preserve_rng_state=True. P8 (static named_modules class snapshot). Tier 6 (named_modules class snapshot). schema_topo_precond: precond is 'activation checkpointing enabled AND a Dropout module exists'.
